[C] FloatingBox variants
|-- FloatingBox = FloatingPane | FloatingBoxArrow
|   |-- DisplayState { rootIds: string[]; nodes: Record<string, FloatingPane> }
|   |-- Panes persist here; arrows are derived from document.edges.
|   `-- The controller manages display updates through shared helpers.
|-- Shared pane geometry and lifetime
|   |-- DisplayNodeBase: id, childIds, expansion, geometryPolicy, expandedGeometry?
|   |-- DisplayGeometry: position, bounds, coordinateSpace
|   |-- Positions and bounds use unscaled CSS pixels.
|   |-- addDisplayNode(state, node, ownerId?); removeDisplayNode(state, id)
|   |-- Removal recursively drops descendants and repairs active child references.
|   `-- setExpansion(state, id, expansion) restores saved expanded geometry.
|-- SelectionRegion captures panel context.
|   |-- kind: 'selection'; sourceBoxId; sourceContentId; sourceAscii; rect; selectedIds
|   `-- SelectionState exclusively manages selection membership.
|-- ProjectedPane holds one of four content variants.
|   |-- content: call-tree | compaction | source-code | code-panel
|   |-- projectionId?; sourceRevisionId?; targetRevisionId?; activeChildId?
|   `-- SourcePaneViewState manages live scrolling; scroll fields are checkpoints.
|-- ConversationPane and DetailPane
|   |-- ConversationPane: thread, draft, canvasAnchor, presentation
|   |-- The semantic bubble anchor is independent of panel presentation.
|   |-- DetailPane: title, ascii, sectionId?
|   `-- Thread resource ownership is unspecified by these records.
`-- Projection and placement computations
    |-- visibleProjectionIds(state, id, mode)
    |-- Stacked mode follows the active child; chained mode follows children.
    |-- measureDisplayNode(state, id, width, height)
    |-- Fixed expanded panes reject automatic measurement updates.
    `-- FloatingPlacement: connection | grid-region | parent | conversation | stored
